objectClass.notes: Static monumental landmark building, exterior shell only. No interior geometry: a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside, so an interior costs draw calls, geometries and VRAM for something nobody sees. Nothing moves, so one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. The university-district hor phak: a six-storey beige mosaic-tiled block with dark spandrel bands, four columns of barred windows either side of one central balcony column with tiled parapet boxes, air-conditioners and laundry in the recesses, a DORMITORY board on a tall tiled parapet band, a shop ground floor of two roller shutters, a stair entrance and a glazed unit under a projecting tiled fascia, plain cream flanks with panel grooves and condenser pairs, and a rusted lattice water-tank tower on the rear-right roof corner.

reasoning: The silhouette is a tiled box with a lattice tank tower on one rear corner, and the identity is the FRONT GRAMMAR: five dark spandrel bands, four columns of barred windows with grime running from the sills, one central column of recessed balconies with tiled parapet boxes standing proud, a DORMITORY board on the parapet, and a shop ground floor of roller shutters, a stair entrance and one glazed unit under a tiled fascia.

The +X flank has its own grammar: cream paint with recessed panel grooves and a pair of condensers per floor, each with a drip stain -- read from the plate and placed against the proxy's +X depth map.
The roof carries a four-leg lattice tower with a railed platform, a ladder and a rusted tank on the rear-right corner, placed from the proxy occupancy rows (x 0.71..0.91 W, z 0.07..0.18 H).
Action readiness is minimal: static exterior shell, box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Twenty barred windows, twenty-five condensers, twenty sill streaks, three shutters and two laundry racks are seventy discrete parts; five InstancedMesh systems carry all of them at one submission each, and every tiled, painted, dark-band and steel part is merged per material, so the whole prop is 15 draw calls.

silhouette.description: A 14.37 x 12.8 m tiled body from the ground to a 20.0 m parapet top; a 0.45 m fascia at 3.3..3.78 and five 2.15 m balcony boxes 0.45 m proud of the +Z face; dark bands 0.03 m proud; condenser pairs 0.27 m proud of each flank; a 3.2 m lattice tower on the rear-right roof corner carrying a 1.9 m tank to 24.0 m. silhouette.envelopeDerivation: Height is the primary axis at 24.0 m: the top of the rooftop water tank. The Meshy v7 proxy of the plate normalises to w:h:d = 0.620 : 1 : 0.555 with the tank tower on top and the body top at 0.82 H. On its +Z depth map at 534.6 px per proxy unit the floor pitch is 128 px; anchoring that at 3.0 m gives 42.66 px/m, so the 613 px body is 14.37 m wide, the 545 px body on the +X map is 12.8 m deep, the parapet top at 854 px is 20.0 m and the tank top 24.0 m. The list-time 12 x 19.5 x 24 was a shophouse-width deep-plot guess; the plate shows the front WIDER than the flank and the proxy footprint is 1.117 : 1, so the declaration was corrected on the asset with this arithmetic before the build. Built box: x -7.45..7.45 (flank condensers 0.27 m proud of the 14.37 m body), y 0..24.0, z -6.4 (rear face) .. +6.85 (balcony boxes and fascia 0.45 m proud) = 13.25, declared 13.3. Origin base-center of the body footprint, so the box is 0.23 m off-centre in z.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to w:h:d = 0.620 : 1 : 0.555 against the corrected declaration 0.621 : 1 : 0.554. Area-weighted band comparison over ten bands: mean |delta width| 0.006 and |delta depth| 0.007 of height. Two residuals are percentile artefacts rather than shape disagreements: band 7 (-0.024 / -0.012) straddles the parapet top where the proxy's deck and the candidate's thin 0.30 m parapet weight the 95th percentile differently, and band 1 (-0.023 / -0.031) is the ground floor, where the proxy fuses the entrance stair, paving and fascia shadow into a fuller footprint than the built 0.45 m paving. Floor pitch 3.0 m from the proxy recess tops at 249/377/507/634/762 px.

merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero4x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Ten components and five repetition systems: 15 of 24. Everything that shares a material is merged -- every tiled part is one draw, every steel strut is one draw -- and the seventy repeated parts ride five InstancedMesh systems.

materials.note: tile covers every front surface; paint covers the flanks, rear and stair; band covers the bands AND the shopfront frame; fourteen of sixteen, four of them (grille, cloth, streak, sign) white or mean bases carrying canvases or per-vertex tones.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 5848 of 32,000. The facade extrusion with thirty holes is ~2,000 of it, the lattice tower ~700, the tank lathe ~800; instancing means the grilles, condensers, streaks and shutters upload once.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: An extrusion with holes for the facade, a notched plan extrusion for the ground body, boxes for walls, bands, liners and struts (each strut a box oriented from point to point), a lathe for the tank. The openings are holes in a Shape, not panels applied, so the reveals are real.
Five InstancedMesh systems carry 70 of the prop's 80 discrete parts: 20 grilles, 25 condensers, 20 sill streaks, 3 shutters, 2 laundry racks.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. Seven seeded post-construction canvases are assigned in the browser only: the mosaic tile, the flank grooves and grime, the window grille, the shutter slats, the tank rust, the sill streaks and the DORMITORY board -- the documented printed-graphic route, none of them the five-canvas procedural set. Under Node the panes and board ship in their flat mean tones and the streak quads at opacity 0.
